description: Nebius AI Studio's Token Factory serverless model catalogue, exposed through an OpenAI-compatible API. This catalogue-only alias is related to Phaseo's Nebius Token Factory gateway routes but is not independently routable.
residency_notes: For public model endpoints, processing location depends on the selected model and is shown in the interface; Nebius documents hosting in the EU (including Finland and France), Israel, and the United States. Dedicated endpoint regions are selected during endpoint configuration. Fine-tuning processing locations are fixed and resulting data is stored in the EU.
prompt_training_notes: Nebius Token Factory says input and output data may be stored and used by default to train smaller models for speculative decoding. Customers can opt out through Zero Data Retention in account settings or by contacting support; with ZDR enabled, prompts and outputs are not stored after processing or used for model training.

sources.notes: Live public model catalogue; authoritative for active serverless model IDs, modalities, regions, context limits, and per-million-token prices.
Nebius's official about page identifies the company as headquartered in Amsterdam, Netherlands.
Provider metadata and model support enrichment; not a Phaseo-routable offer.

verification.notes: Provider identity, OpenAI-compatible base URL, live catalogue relationship, pricing feed, and region-dependent serverless availability verified against Nebius primary sources. Individual model records retain their own lifecycle verification.
